from common import * if __name__=='__main__': save_source(__file__) import matplotlib matplotlib.use('Agg') import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import numpy as np s=read(BASE/'docs/study-summary.json') names=sorted([n for n in s['primary'] if n.startswith('quantile')],key=lambda n:int(n[8:])) if not names or 'control_new' not in s['primary']:raise SystemExit(0) plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','axes.spines.top':False,'axes.spines.right':False}) fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.8),layout='constrained') for ax,key,scale,title in [(axes[0],'net_ann',100,'Top3 x H5 net annualized return (%)'),(axes[1],'net_sharpe',1,'Top3 x H5 net Sharpe')]: vals=[s['primary'][n][key]*scale for n in names];x=np.arange(len(names)) bars=ax.bar(x,vals,color=['#8c9ba8' if n in REUSED else '#246a9c' for n in names]);ax.bar_label(bars,fmt='%.2f',fontsize=8,padding=3) ax.axhline(s['primary']['control_new'][key]*scale,label='Continuous H20 control',color='#b85736',linestyle='--') ax.set_xticks(x,[n[8:] for n in names]);ax.set(xlabel='Equal-count bin number n (grey: prior study)',title=title);ax.margins(y=.20);ax.legend(fontsize=8) fig.suptitle('H20 / patience50 | fixed five-seed ensemble | historical selection window') fig.savefig(BASE/'reports/label-grading.png',dpi=160,bbox_inches='tight');plt.close(fig) paired=[n for n in names if n in s['paired_sensitivity']] fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.8),layout='constrained');x=np.arange(len(paired));w=.36 for shift,t,label,color in [(-w/2,'old','Old-label input','#8c9ba8'),(w/2,'new','New-label input','#246a9c')]: vals=[s['paired_sensitivity'][n][t]['net_ann']*100 for n in paired];b=axes[0].bar(x+shift,vals,w,label=label,color=color);axes[0].bar_label(b,fmt='%.1f',fontsize=7,padding=2) vals=[s['paired_sensitivity'][n]['head_overlap']['3']*100 for n in paired] b=axes[1].bar(x,vals,color='#397957');axes[1].bar_label(b,fmt='%.1f',fontsize=8,padding=3) if 'control' in s['paired_sensitivity']:axes[1].axhline(s['paired_sensitivity']['control']['head_overlap']['3']*100,color='#b85736',linestyle='--',label='Continuous control') for ax,title in zip(axes,['Paired Top3 x H5 net annualized return (%)','Paired Top3 selection overlap (%)']): ax.set_xticks(x,[n[8:] for n in paired]);ax.set(xlabel='Equal-count bin number n',title=title);ax.margins(y=.20);ax.legend(fontsize=8) fig.suptitle('Old/new label sensitivity | n3/n7 reuse identical inputs, not independent fits') fig.savefig(BASE/'reports/label-sensitivity.png',dpi=160,bbox_inches='tight');plt.close(fig) p=BASE/'reports/detail.html';text=p.read_text() for heading,filename in
